```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
setwd(getwd())
```

```{r}
gecko_lib_a <- read_tsv("./human_geckov2_library_a_09mar2015.tsv", col_names = c("sgRNA", "spacer", "gene"))
gecko_lib_b <- read_tsv("./human_geckov2_library_b_09mar2015.tsv", col_names = c("sgRNA", "spacer", "gene"))

gecko <- rbind(gecko_lib_a, gecko_lib_b)

gecko <- gecko %>% 
  select(-sgRNA) %>%
  arrange(gene)


run_length <- rle(gecko$gene)$lengths
sequential_number <- sequence(run_length)

gecko <- gecko %>%
  mutate(sgRNA = paste("sg", gene, "_", sequential_number, sep = "")) %>%
  relocate(sgRNA, .before = spacer) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  drop_na()

write_tsv(gecko, "./human_geckov2_library_combined_09mar2015.tsv", col_names = FALSE)


```
